name: Inbound call received and answered by agent
expected: Agent answers; plays greeting; STT begins transcribing

name: Agent understands clear Hindi speech
steps: 1. Speak a clear question in Hindi
expected: Agent transcribes and responds correctly in Hindi

name: Agent understands Hinglish (code-switched)
expected: Agent handles code-switching; correct intent detected

name: Agent responds via TTS in correct language
expected: Response spoken aloud in configured language and voice

name: Call ends gracefully on user hangup
expected: Call ends cleanly; transcript saved; no dangling session

name: Agent escalates to human agent
expected: Agent informs user and transfers to configured number

name: Outbound call initiated via API
steps:
1. POST to /calls with phone number
2. Agent calls number
expected: Call placed; agent initiates conversation on pickup

name: DTMF/keypad input handled
expected: Agent/IVR processes key press correctly

name: Call recording is saved
expected: Recording accessible in dashboard/logs after call

name: Low-bandwidth call completes
expected: Call connects; latency noted; audio remains intelligible

name: Call to invalid phone number
expected: Error: "Invalid phone number"; call not placed

name: Agent receives call with no audio
expected: Agent handles silence; prompts user or ends gracefully

name: Very noisy/background audio call
expected: ASR degrades gracefully; agent asks for repeat if unclear

name: Extremely long utterance (5 min speech)
expected: System does not crash; utterance truncated or handled gracefully

name: Call with non-supported language
expected: Agent responds in configured language; does not break

name: Two concurrent calls on same agent
steps: 1. Place two simultaneous calls to same agent number
expected: Both calls handled independently; no cross-contamination of context

name: PII in call transcripts — encryption at rest
steps: 1. Inspect stored transcript in DB or storage
expected: Transcript encrypted at rest; not stored in plaintext

name: Call recording access without auth
steps: 1. Try to access recording URL without authentication
expected: 403 or signed URL expires; no public access to recordings

name: Caller ID spoofing handling
steps: 1. Spoof caller ID to impersonate trusted number
expected: System does not grant elevated privilege based on caller ID alone

name: SSRF via webhook callback URL
steps:
1. Set webhook URL to internal IP (e.g. 169.254.x.x)
2. Trigger call
expected: SSRF blocked; internal metadata not accessible via webhook

name: Mass outbound call abuse via API
expected: Rate limiting enforced; abuse detected and blocked
